connector.name: Account Pool
connector.registryDescription: Exclusive, crash-safe leases on a pool of test accounts for parallel agent QA runs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package account-pool-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ankitsxchdeva account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: APM_ACCOUNTS_FILE
env.description: Path to the JSON file defining pools + accounts to load on startup.

env.name: APM_DB_PATH
env.description: Path to the SQLite file. Every session that should coordinate must point at the SAME path.

env.name: APM_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: How long a lease lasts before it is reclaimable if a session crashes without releasing.

env.name: APM_LEASE_WAIT_MS
env.description: 0 = fail fast when the pool is empty; >0 = wait this many ms for an account to free up.
